constraints.name: ck_analytics_batches_current_success
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT is_current OR status = 'SUCCEEDED'::text AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND validation_passed AND validated_at IS NOT NULL AND content_hash IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: pk_analytics_product_daily
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (batch_id, day, product_id, category, issue_tag)

constraints.name: ck_analytics_product_risk_eligible_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (data_status = 'ELIGIBLE'::text AND score IS NOT NULL AND rank IS NOT NULL AND risk_band IS NOT NULL AND score >= 0::numeric AND score <= 100::numeric AND rank > 0 AND (risk_band = ANY (ARRAY['NORMAL'::text, 'WATCH'::text, 'HIGH'::text])) OR (data_status = ANY (ARRAY['LOW_SAMPLE'::text, 'DATA_MISSING'::text, 'QUALITY_BLOCKED'::text])) AND score IS NULL AND rank IS NULL AND risk_band IS NULL)

constraints.name: pk_analytics_product_voc_daily
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (batch_id, scope_key, product_id, day, primary_issue)

constraints.name: ck_assignments_cycle_time
constraints.definition: CHECK (cycle_no >= 1 AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= assigned_at))

constraints.name: ck_automation_control_reason
constraints.definition: CHECK (reason_code::text = ANY (ARRAY['INITIAL_STATE'::character varying, 'SAFETY_INCIDENT'::character varying, 'OPERATOR_PAUSE'::character varying, 'VERIFICATION_COMPLETE'::character varying, 'INCIDENT_RESOLVED'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: ck_automation_control_history_reason
constraints.definition: CHECK (reason_code::text = ANY (ARRAY['INITIAL_STATE'::character varying, 'SAFETY_INCIDENT'::character varying, 'OPERATOR_PAUSE'::character varying, 'VERIFICATION_COMPLETE'::character varying, 'INCIDENT_RESOLVED'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: ck_automation_jobs_handoff_request
constraints.definition: CHECK (job_kind::text = 'AUTO'::text AND reason_code IS NULL OR job_kind::text = 'HANDOFF'::text AND source_message_id IS NOT NULL AND reason_code IS NOT NULL AND (reason_code::text = ANY (ARRAY['CUSTOMER_REQUEST'::character varying, 'DISSATISFIED'::character varying, 'COMPLEX_ISSUE'::character varying, 'OTHER'::character varying, 'HUMAN_CONTINUATION'::character varying]::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_automation_jobs_lease
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'RUNNING'::text AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL OR status <> 'RUNNING'::text AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND lease_owner IS NULL)

constraints.name: ck_followup_actions_cancelled
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'CANCELLED'::text AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL AND (cancellation_reason::text = ANY (ARRAY['CUSTOMER_WITHDREW'::character varying, 'NO_LONGER_NEEDED'::character varying, 'DUPLICATE'::character varying, 'OTHER'::character varying]::text[])) OR status <> 'CANCELLED'::text AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND cancellation_reason IS NULL)

constraints.name: ck_followup_actions_completed
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'DONE'::text AND completed_at IS NOT NULL OR status <> 'DONE'::text AND completed_at IS NULL)

constraints.name: ck_followup_actions_cycle
constraints.definition: CHECK (ticket_id IS NOT NULL AND cycle_no IS NOT NULL AND cycle_no >= 1 AND responsibility_cycle_no IS NOT NULL AND responsibility_cycle_no >= cycle_no OR product_id IS NOT NULL AND cycle_no IS NULL AND responsibility_cycle_no IS NULL)

constraints.name: ck_followup_actions_due
constraints.definition: CHECK (due_at IS NULL OR due_at >= created_at)

constraints.name: ck_followup_actions_notes
constraints.definition: CHECK ((public_note IS NULL OR length(public_note) <= 4000) AND (internal_note IS NULL OR length(internal_note) <= 10000))

constraints.name: ck_followup_actions_product_block
constraints.definition: CHECK (product_id IS NULL OR NOT blocks_resolution)

constraints.name: ck_followup_actions_target
constraints.definition: CHECK (ticket_id IS NULL AND product_id IS NOT NULL OR ticket_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: ck_idempotency_keys_operation
constraints.definition: CHECK (operation::text = ANY (ARRAY['CREATE_TICKET'::character varying, 'REOPEN'::character varying, 'REQUEST_AGENT'::character varying, 'FOLLOWUP_CREATE'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: ck_idempotency_keys_snapshot
constraints.definition: CHECK (operation::text = 'CREATE_TICKET'::text OR response_snapshot IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_idempotency_keys_target
constraints.definition: CHECK (operation::text = 'FOLLOWUP_CREATE'::text AND followup_id IS NOT NULL AND ticket_id IS NULL OR operation::text <> 'FOLLOWUP_CREATE'::text AND followup_id IS NULL AND ticket_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_messages_body
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM body)) >= 1 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM body)) <= 10000)

constraints.name: ck_messages_public_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (visibility::text <> 'PUBLIC'::text OR role = 'CUSTOMER'::text AND direction = 'IN'::text OR (role = ANY (ARRAY['AGENT'::text, 'ASSISTANT'::text, 'SYSTEM'::text])) AND direction = 'OUT'::text)

constraints.name: ck_staff_permissions_permission
constraints.definition: CHECK (permission::text = ANY (ARRAY['EXCEPTION_QUEUE_READ'::character varying, 'UNROUTED_QUEUE_READ'::character varying, 'AUTOMATION_READ'::character varying, 'AUTOMATION_STOP'::character varying, 'AUTOMATION_RESUME'::character varying, 'RETENTION_TEAM_REVIEW'::character varying, 'RETENTION_GLOBAL_REVIEW'::character varying]::text[]))

constraints.name: ck_tickets_order_product
constraints.definition: CHECK (order_id IS NULL OR product_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_tickets_resolved_at
constraints.definition: CHECK (status <> 'RESOLVED'::text OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolution_mode IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: fk_tickets_owned_order_product
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id, customer_id, product_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id, customer_id, product_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.csflow_control_history_immutable()
